pipeline.title: AbbVie pens $1.4B deal for deprioritized IBD drug from Nxera
pipeline.summary: AbbVie has added another angle to its relationship with Nxera, with the Big Pharma paying $100 million upfront for a phase 1 inflammatory bowel disease candidate.

pipeline.title: Rhythm doubles down on LG obesity license, raising payout to as much as $855M
pipeline.summary: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals and LG Chem have rewritten the terms of their licensing agreement for the oral obesity and hyperphagia drug bivamelagon, growing to $855 million in scheduled payments from the earlier milestone-based deal of $305 million.

pipeline.title: AbbVie abandons phase 2 solid tumor drug over ‘limited benefit’
pipeline.summary: AbbVie has scrapped a phase 2 solid tumor drug after deciding that the monoclonal antibody was unlikely to best the current standard of care, Fierce has learned.

pipeline.title: Pfizer pares back obesity pipeline, drops phase 2-stage lung disease candidate
pipeline.summary: Pfizer has axed a phase 2 pulmonary arterial hypertension program on business grounds, dealing a setback to a long-running effort to treat the lung disease by targeting BMP9.

pipeline.title: FDA grants uniQure’s Huntington’s gene therapy priority review, teeing up ‘defining milestone’
pipeline.summary: The FDA has accepted uniQure’s priority review and application for its gene therapy treatment for Huntington’s disease.

pipeline.title: Inovio’s DNA-based immunotherapy Voceryq approved by FDA for rare HPV airway disease
pipeline.summary: After an initial FDA scare that threatened its path for an accelerated approval, Inovio’s Voceryq, the first plasmid DNA-based immunotherapy, has earned a go-ahead to treat a rare HPV-driven disease.

pipeline.title: How advanced AI can improve clinical trial decision-making
pipeline.summary: Life science foundation models can help teams anticipate patient outcomes and pressure-test trial designs.

pipeline.title: Sanofi stops development of Nurix-partnered immune drug
pipeline.summary: The decision sparked a sell-off in Nurix shares as well as analyst debate about the prospects of drugs designed to degrade a tough-to-reach protein called STAT6.

pipeline.title: Samsung Bio union vows strike as labor negotiations stall
pipeline.summary: Samsung Biologics' labor negotiations have stalled out amid mounting tension between union members and management. In response, the union says 400 employees will strike starting November 6.

pipeline.title: Novo gets much-needed lift as Wegovy pill tops Wall Street forecasts
pipeline.summary: The drug’s third-quarter sales numbers came in well above consensus estimates, widening Novo’s early edge over Eli Lilly in the latest battleground for weight loss medicines.

pipeline.title: Novo catches Wegovy pill tailwind in Q3 as CEO eyes new launch horizons in 2027
pipeline.summary: With a modest improvement to guidance and rosy launch expectations for 2027 girding a solid quarter for its GLP-1 franchise, Novo appears to be gradually winning back the confidence of some of its shareholders.

pipeline.title: Madrigal’s former clinical development head files whistleblower lawsuit alleging Rezdiffra safety cover-up
pipeline.summary: Madrigal Pharmaceuticals is facing a whistleblower lawsuit alleging that senior leadership censored serious liver-injury data related to its breakthrough MASH drug Rezdiffra and retaliated against the firm’s top clinical development head who tried to sound the alarm.

pipeline.title: CVS to split into two companies in stunning strategic about-face
pipeline.summary: The breakup, which will separate Aetna and Caremark from CVS’ retail pharmacies, is an indictment of the dogma that bigger is always better in the healthcare industry.

pipeline.title: Biopharma likely to climb higher after ‘blue wave,’ analysts say
pipeline.summary: Historical data suggests the sector outperforms after midterm elections. And Democrats, newly in control of Congress, have “bigger fish to fry” than drug pricing, analysts said.

pipeline.title: BMS Canada teams with TANK Worldwide, Ogilvy Health to turn autumn leaves into melanoma awareness campaign
pipeline.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb Canada is partnering with TANK Worldwide and Ogilvy Health on a new “What Summer Leaves Behind” skin cancer awareness campaign.

pipeline.title: Minghui grants ASKA Japanese rights to sub-q TED candidate in $440M deal
pipeline.summary: China’s Minghui Pharmaceutical has licensed its late-stage thyroid eye disease candidate to ASKA Pharmaceutical for up to $440 million, granting the Japanese drugmaker exclusive development and commercialization rights in its home country.

pipeline.title: Blackstone Life Sciences teams up with Boston Scientific in $455M heart pump deal
pipeline.summary: Blackstone Life Sciences has penned a $455 million collaboration with Boston Scientific to co-fund the development of the medtech’s next-generation miniature heart pump system.

pipeline.title: Boehringer returns to Sino Biopharma in $7.4B deal for preclinical TCEs, ADCs
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has returned to China to satisfy its appetite for antibody-drug conjugates and T-cell engagers.

pipeline.title: nPhase rakes in $30M to expand AI-native clinical data platform
pipeline.summary: Clinical research company nPhase has closed a $30 million series D financing round to expand its AI-native clinical data platform.

pipeline.title: Ultragenyx shrinks workforce and axes assets to halve R&D spend
pipeline.summary: Ultragenyx is laying off 20% of its workforce and axing drug development programs to cut its annual R&D budget to half of the amount it spent in 2025.

pipeline.title: Sanofi scraps STAT6 degrader from Nurix just 2 months after entering clinic
pipeline.summary: Sanofi has decided to end work on a STAT6 degrader from Nurix just two months after taking the inflammatory disease drug into the clinic.

pipeline.title: Novo’s CEO still looking for deals to ‘close some of the gaps,’ as misfires hit profits
pipeline.summary: Novo’s CEO has told Fierce that the company remains on the hunt for deals that “close some of the gaps” in its pipeline, as the Big Pharma reports billions of dollars in impairment charges from a string of recent clinical misses.

pipeline.title: Servier’s $1.6B muscular dystrophy bet on Edgewise delivers quick-fire pivotal failure
pipeline.summary: Servier’s decision to bet $1.55 billion on Edgewise Therapeutics’ muscular dystrophy program ahead of pivotal data has backfired. Five months after striking the deal, the French drugmaker has reported that a Becker muscular dystrophy trial missed its primary and secondary endpoin

pipeline.title: Smith+Nephew held failed talks with J&J over potential orthopedics combination
pipeline.summary: Smith+Nephew held talks with Johnson & Johnson’s hip-and-knee replacement unit DePuy Synthes aimed at a potential combination with its orthopedics unit.

pipeline.title: Insulin pump maker MiniMed names David Segal chief medical officer
pipeline.summary: MiniMed has hired David Segal, M.D., as its new chief medical officer, bringing in a diabetes care and digital health veteran as the company enters its next chapter as an independent business.

pipeline.title: Amgen's quality chief to retire as internal successor steps up
pipeline.summary: Jackie Elbonne, Ph.D., announced her retirement after 35 years in the biopharma industry, leaving Amgen's chief quality officer role to her deputy, Aine Hanly, Ph.D.

pipeline.title: Madrigal’s Rezdiffra storms past blockbuster milestone as CEO hails ‘accelerating’ MASH market
pipeline.summary: To Madrigal CEO Bill Sibold, “it’s hard to find a more attractive growth opportunity in biotech” than MASH, as the company’s Rezdiffra, the first FDA-approved MASH therapy, crossed the $1 billion mark in annual sales.

pipeline.title: Vertex, ahead of FDA decision, calms fears surrounding kidney drug
pipeline.summary: On a conference call, executives expressed conviction in the coming launch of an IgA nephropathy medicine viewed by Wall Street investors as important to Vertex’s future.

pipeline.title: As Bayer spots pharma recovery, questions resurface over potential crop science split
pipeline.summary: Bayer’s pharmaceutical business may finally be entering a long-awaited growth cycle, but CEO Bill Anderson still can’t quite escape the lingering questions around a potential crop science split.

pipeline.title: Pfizer delivers Q3 beat as post-COVID comeback gains momentum
pipeline.summary: Pfizer's third-quarter performance bested Wall Street estimates thanks to an Eliquis beat and 37% growth from acquired products.

pipeline.title: Rising Stars: Publicis Health’s Ariel Rabinowitz knows what it takes to 'meet people where they are'
pipeline.summary: Publicis Health’s Ariel Rabinowitz learned lessons about health literacy, trust and access firsthand while teaching at a school in the Bronx.

pipeline.title: Lonza bets big on US growth, snaps up Merck KGaA’s CDMO business
pipeline.summary: Lonza will purchase the German Merck’s U.S.-based CDMO network for mid-triple-digit million euros. Besides five sites, the deal will bolster Lonza’s prowess in rapidly growing sectors such as cell and gene therapy, bioconjugates, viral vectors and advanced drug-delivery technolog

pipeline.title: Medicare Part D premiums are spiking 50% on average next year, KFF finds
pipeline.summary: The health policy think tank urged seniors to shop carefully for prescription drug coverage during Medicare open enrollment, given skyrocketing premiums and wide variance in costs between plans.

pipeline.title: UniQure gets an FDA decision date; Teva scraps brain drug study
pipeline.summary: The FDA appears likely to hold an advisory committee for UniQure’s closely watched Huntington’s disease gene therapy. Elsewhere, a biotech’s share price was cut in half following a regulatory setback.

pipeline.title: AbbVie invests £120M in UK, including expanded R&D site
pipeline.summary: AbbVie is investing 120 million pounds ($160 million) to expand its U.K. R&D presence, in a show of faith in the country’s life sciences sector.

pipeline.title: Philips sets aside $322M for proposed DOJ settlement over sleep apnea device recall
pipeline.summary: Philips’ Respironics division has reached an “agreement in principle” with the U.S. Department of Justice to settle a long-running investigation into its recall of potentially defective sleep apnea devices.

pipeline.title: BioArctic left out in the cold as Novartis walks away from $800M neuro collab
pipeline.summary: Just 14 months after Novartis signed an $800 million biobucks neuroscience partnership with BioArctic, the Swiss pharma has walked away from the deal.

pipeline.title: GE HealthCare debuts ceiling-mounted AI image guidance system
pipeline.summary: GE HealthCare has debuted Allia Celeo, a ceiling-mounted image guiding system, at the Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (TCT) 2026 conference.

pipeline.title: Abbott's Tectonic test looks to shift artery disease treatment with ‘early’ win
pipeline.summary: Abbott has posted positive 30-day results from its Tectonic trial of the investigational SonicForce Coronary IVL System in coronary artery disease (CAD), but analysts urge caution on results.

pipeline.title: Hansoh hit with FDA write-up after inspection
pipeline.summary: In a recently disclosed report, the FDA outlined manufacturing concerns at a facility run by China's Hansoh Pharma, with sterilization issues among the agency's chief complaints.

pipeline.title: Karyopharm, deep in debt, to sell itself in bankruptcy
pipeline.summary: The parent of cell therapy maker Gamida Cell will be the lead bidder in a court-supervised auction of Karyopharm, which recently cut a forbearance deal to push off debt payments.

pipeline.title: Sumitomo's Gemtesa power couple takes the wheel in road-trip themed overactive bladder awareness push
pipeline.summary: Actress Holly Robinson Peete and her husband, former professional quarterback Rodney Peete, are hitting the road for another starring role in Sumitomo Pharma America’s Gemtesa campaign, “Time To Go.”

pipeline.title: Compass points to unmet need in depression as landmark psychedelic nears market
pipeline.summary: Compass Pathways has published survey data showing how treatment-resistant depression affects patients and their caregivers, laying the groundwork for the launch of its psychedelic therapy.

pipeline.title: Karyopharm files Chapter 11, lines up Ayrmid as lead bidder in planned merger
pipeline.summary: In an answer to Karyopharm's cash crisis, Irish biotech Ayrmid has agreed to make the first bid on the struggling biopharma's assets in a court supervised auction, teeing up a potential hematology merger.

pipeline.title: OpenAI-funded Biossil snags Theriva's unwanted antibiotic degrader portfolio for up to $91M
pipeline.summary: Canada's OpenAI-backed startup Biossil Labs has extended its pharma shopping spree with a deal worth up to $91 million for Theriva Biologics' deprioritized early- to mid-stage portfolio of antibiotic-degrading enzymes.

pipeline.title: Keytruda biosimilars are coming — but they face an uphill battle
pipeline.summary: A patent cliff is fast approaching for Merck’s flagship blockbuster, but the deck might be stacked against its biosimilars gaining widespread traction.

pipeline.title: Dexcom taps celebrities, influencers for ‘A Letter to Diabetes’ campaign
pipeline.summary: Dexcom is marking National Diabetes Awareness Month and World Diabetes Day in November with a new campaign asking people affected by diabetes to write a letter to the condition.

pipeline.title: Teva ends trial of one of its original line-up of innovative meds over futility
pipeline.summary: Teva has given up on a key trial of one of its original line-up of innovative medicines.

pipeline.title: Fresenius strikes WuXi Bio biosimilars deal for up to 37 assets, targeting €370B market
pipeline.summary: Fresenius has inked a broad deal with WuXi Biologics to scale its biosimilars portfolio to as many as 66 molecules targeting a combined originator market worth over 370 billion euros ($415 billion).

pipeline.title: Earnings roundup: AstraZeneca’s cost cuts, Alnylam’s slump and Regeneron’s resilience
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca will “redeploy resources” through a new restructuring program. Meanwhile, Alnylam shares sold off on fears surrounding a top drug and investors rewarded Regeneron for a record quarter.

pipeline.title: Sanofi tips Dupixent to reap most rewards from Eli Lilly’s Ebglyss ad push
pipeline.summary: Sanofi has predicted that Dupixent will receive “the majority of the benefit” from the direct-to-consumer marketing campaigns that Eli Lilly is running to support its rival drug Ebglyss.

pipeline.title: As Skyrizi and Rinvoq dominate AbbVie's Q3, analysts ask what's next
pipeline.summary: Analysts were eager to learn more about AbbVie's plans beyond immunology as Rinvoq and Skyrizi headlined the Chicago drugmaker's third-quarter earnings.

pipeline.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.
